description: This file is a PHP class implementation for managing file downloads in the OpenCart admin panel. It includes methods for listing, adding, editing, deleting, uploading, and reporting on downloads, as well as handling file downloads and autocompletion.

classes.name: Download
classes.description: Controller class for handling download management in the OpenCart admin interface, providing CRUD operations, file upload/download, and reports.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the main download list page with header, footer, and side columns.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches and returns a list of downloads based on filters and pagination.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a download entry.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving of a new or existing download entry.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Fetches and formats download report data with pagination.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Handles file uploads for downloads, including validation and moving files.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Serves a file download to the user.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Provides autocomplete suggestions for download names.
